dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: You want a fortune slip?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Geez, she's so cold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I'd like one...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Got it. Here's how it goes. First, shake this... thing over here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't it called a Fortune Slip Box?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Yes. A Bamboo Slip will drop out from it. Give it to me, and I'll give you a matching strip of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm pretty sure they say it's a Fortune Slip...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Whatever.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's got a question! If... What do we do if we get one that means bad luck?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: It's fate. You got a problem with that? Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Isn't there that shelf-like thing outside we can use to...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Tsk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did she seriously just say "tsk"?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Let me see... Oh right, so it's like this. "Tie the inauspicious slip onto the Fortune Slip Hanger to change ill fortune to good"...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, right! If you get a slip with ill fortune, just tie it to that shelf, that'll do.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Huh, what a bunch of... No, sorry. We at the Grand Narukami Shrine are most gentle indeed. Even if you should draw a slip with bad luck, you shall have a chance to turn it around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something about this doesn't seem right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go draw a fortune slip, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Give me that bamboo slip.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: R—Right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This shrine really seems to lack the whole divine affection thing, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see how our luck's going...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. You can only draw one fortune slip each day. Please remember that.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: It's too tiring otherwise... Wait, no. If not, you won't be able to use the Fortune Slip Hanger to... No, that's not right either. What was I supposed to say?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: "Fortune slips are the manifestation of our archon's will. It is our place as mortals to respect it and do all we can."

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: See? Elegantly put. So please remember, you can only draw one fortune slip each day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Hey, {NICKNAME}!)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (According to that Ms. Gendou, this Ms. Gendou is...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Yeah, a Fatui knockoff.)

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, we meet again. Want to check your fortune as well? Or...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: If you need a listening ear or if you have something to discuss, I can help too.

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: Is that so? Hehe, that's what many people have told me lately. It feels good.

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: It's always been my dream to work at a beautiful shrine like this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Still, she seems like she actually enjoys this job.)

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: #So {NICKNAME}, how may I help you today?

choices.text: I'm just here to see you.

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: Me... Huh? Ah? S—Sorry, I don't understand what you... what you mean...

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: P—Please allow me to cool down a little...

response.speaker: Gendou Ringo
response.text: I get it now. Come find me if you have any questions.

choices.text: (Wait for Ms. Gendou to contact us.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Hands over the fortune slip) In the middle of a hazy night.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: "Cloudy."

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here. Your strip of paper.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. "No such thing" exists at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: You are so reliable... If only the F...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Uh... I mean, "If only I, the foolish Gendou Ringo, could witness your prowess in combat!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You will someday, don't worry.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the strip of paper...

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the Fortune Slip? It works like this.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: First, you have to shake the Fortune Slip box till a Bamboo Slip falls out. Then, give me the Bamboo Slip and I will give the corresponding Fortune Slip to you.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: If it is an inauspicious fortune, you can knot it on the Fortune Slip Hanger to turn bad luck into good luck... That's about all there is to it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know so much.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Well, after all, these are... the basic skills of a shrine maiden!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Give the Special Bamboo Slip

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Alright, please pass that Bamboo Slip to me... Huh, actually, you know what? I have the faintest impression that you didn't shake the slip cylinder at all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Really? Must've been a trick of the light.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. You just weren't paying attention, Ms. Gendou.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: M—Me? Not paying attention? C—Come now, that... that never happened. I just didn't sleep so well last night, that's all. Sorry for worrying you!

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Here's your Fortune Slip.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (How did it go? We should've gotten the powder onto her, right?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Without a hitch, Paimon.)

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Um, why are you two standing there while looking so somber? Did you get a slip with Misfortune on it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, just a Modest Fortune.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Oh, I wouldn't be too sad about that. A Modest Fortune is not bad, either. Perhaps you might encounter some challenges, but I'm sure that there's a happy ending waiting for you on the other side.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Someone with a heart as good as yours will definitely see such fortunes through. Well, that's what I believe, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How've things been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Thanks for your concern. I'm feeling great, really! That I was able to become a real shrine maiden is thanks to your help, and that of many others.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: I will stay here, and I will pray for you all in earnest. If you ever have something on your mind, I'll be happy to hear you out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you heard anything from Momoyo?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: I fear that Ms. Momoyo had already left by the time I returned to this place, so I missed the opportunity to thank her in person.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Still, I believe that we will meet again in future.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: See you! May your day be blessed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hey, Ms. Gendou?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: #...O—Oh, why, hello, {NICKNAME}! Are you here to decipher your fortune slip today?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In the middle of a hazy night.

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. "No such thing" exists at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's been a while since there's been anything, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Um, th—that has been case, hasn't it? And perhaps there won't be any in the future ever again, really...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you just say?

dialogues.speaker: Gendou Ringo
dialogues.text: Um, nothing, nothing! Don't worry about it!
